description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports essential React libraries, the main App component, and a CSS file. It initializes the React DOM and renders the App component within 'React.StrictMode' into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root DOM node for rendering a React application.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
